description_en: Returns the processing result of an extension to Operation Center. Call this operation when an Operation Center process is blocked by the extension
description_zh: 所属扩展程序的运维中心回调API，当运维中心的流程被扩展程序卡住后,调用UpdateWorkbenchEventResult返回扩展程序的处理结果
name: UpdateWorkbenchEventResult

parameters.help_en: The message ID. You can obtain the MessageId only from the OpenEvent extension point event message generated when a process in the Operation Center is blocked by an extension. The ExtensionCode must be the code of an extension that is registered in the DataWorks console and is handling the process. You can use ListExtensions and ListCheckProcesses only to query existing configurations or processes. These operations cannot create valid events
parameters.help_zh: MessageId 只能从运维中心流程被扩展程序卡住时产生的 OpenEvent 扩展点事件消息中获取；ExtensionCode 必须是已在 DataWorks 控制台注册且正在处理该流程的扩展程序编码。ListExtensions 和 ListCheckProcesses 只能用于查询已有配置或流程，不能创建有效事件
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en: The callback result. A value of OK indicates that the check is successful. A value of FAIL indicates that the check fails
parameters.help_zh: 回调结果，OK代表检查成功，FAIL代表检查失败
parameters.name: check_result

parameters.help_en: The reason for the check failure
parameters.name: check_result_tip
